# Corey McDaniel
> Personal site of Corey McDaniel: an interactive Matrix terminal entry page, a home page with monthly scripture encouragement, a privacy-first browser utilities toolkit, and useful works.

## Pages
- https://coreymcdaniel.com/ : interactive "Enter the Matrix" terminal entry page
- https://coreymcdaniel.com/home/ : main home page (monthly verse card, utilities, works)
- https://coreymcdaniel.com/projects/clothing/ : Clothing Design, apparel mockup studio (work in progress)
- https://coreymcdaniel.com/projects/cmd-r/ : CMD-R, simple online game and one-minute stress reliever
- https://coreymcdaniel.com/projects/cognitive-prism/ : Cognitive Prism, a synesthetic thought engine (type a thought, see it as crystals)
- https://coreymcdaniel.com/projects/funding-gateway/ : Government Funding Pathways, an independent educational guide to nonprofit grants and small-business financing (not affiliated with any government agency)
- https://coreymcdaniel.com/projects/vacation-matchmaker/ : Vacation Property Matchmaker, a 60-second island vacation condo preference quiz
- https://coreymcdaniel.com/utilities/ : All the Best Internet Utilities, ~127 free browser tools that run locally
- https://coreymcdaniel.com/utilities/llms.txt : utilities details
- https://coreymcdaniel.com/quotes/ : Quick Print
- https://coreymcdaniel.com/works/photo.html : Photo tool
- https://coreymcdaniel.com/legal/terms.html : Terms and privacy
